en.description:
Crush your enemies! Exercise self care!

Every step you take, every workout you finish, every ring you close feeds something on your wrist. Inner Orc turns your real-world activity into the care and feeding of your own orc companion, living right on your Apple Watch.

Your orc runs on three simple systems:

Energy builds passively throughout the day and surges when you close your Activity rings. Spend it to send your orc out on quests. Morale reflects how consistently you're showing up. Mindful minutes lift it, quests keep it steady, and letting too much time pass without checking in will let it slip. Quests send your orc off down a scrolling pixel-art road, walking, fighting, and coming home with rewards. The more engaged you are, the more your orc can take on.

Check in throughout the day to keep your orc thriving, start quests when you've earned the energy, and watch your progress right from the watch face with a built-in complication that always shows what your orc is up to. As your orc gains experience, they can select a class and level up over time with visual evolutions at step. Reach level six to unlock exciting epic classes.

No accounts, no ads, no subscriptions. Just your watch, your movement, and your orc.

Inner Orc uses HealthKit data (Activity rings and Mindful Minutes) to power gameplay. Your health data stays on your device.
en.releaseNotes:
• Daily Crafting Bounty: turn in a Steel Bar, a Plank and a Leather Roll once a day for XP and morale
• Your watch face complication now shows your orc’s energy between quests
• Trade XP for War Paint on the Chroma screen
• Mounts now cost 5 Beast Tracks
• New orcs start with 90 morale
• New attack animations for Monk and Rogue
• Fixed a weapon aura crash on Apple Watch SE and a cave battle freeze
en.subtitle: A Pixel Idle Fitness RPG

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
Version 1.1.0 brings some nice quality-of-life improvements to gathering and crafting mini-games. 

- Perfect gathering attempts have a chance to give additional rewards for all games 
- Perfect repair attempts for non-broken items now set item durability to 120%
- Perfect Alchemy and Cooking mini-game attempts now result in rewarding additional items
- Durability coloring now applied to the repair section of crafting mini-games to easier identify items in a critical state
- "Hit" tolerance for Mining and Blacksmithing mini-games have been increased, so getting a success should now be a bit easier
- The Haste Potion recipe now requires three plants, but will create three haste potions instead of one
- If a unique item is broken, instead of being destroyed it is now returned to inventory in a broken item that can be repaired

Inner Orc 1.2 is the biggest update yet. Your orc can finally look the part.

NEW 
• Mounts: from level 4, ride a mount on the quest road instead of walking. Track down Beast Tracks with the new daily Mount Search quest to tame one for your class. Riding also cuts quest energy costs by 10%. 
• Epic Mounts: at level 6, upgrade to an Epic mount for a 15% quest discount. The Druid gets an Epic Bird Form. 
• Chromas: recolor your orc in Crimson, Frost, Gilded, Shadow or Royal. Spend War Paint, found on Raid, Infiltrate, Subjugate and Shard Hunt. 
• Weapon Auras: Fire, Ice, Shadow, Poison and Blessed particles trail your weapon through every swing. Level-6 orcs earn Wildcore Shards from the new Shard Hunt quest. 
• Monk Animations: Monks now have more exciting combat animations that escalate from level-to-level and aren't just a simple jab/jab-cross
• Hall of Heroes: browse your retired orcs, drawn in the chroma and aura they wore. 

IMPROVED 
• Accessibility has been improved across the board thanks to increased font sizes, better contrast on buttons, and more.
• Rare gear from Pillage, Plunder and Ransack gets 3% more likely with every miss, until it drops. 
• Broken rare gear goes to your inventory so you can repair it. It is no longer destroyed. 
• Starting a quest is now a nicer experience: tap a quest for details, pick your potions there and press Engage. 
• Class selection shows a short tagline for each class, with a details screen before you commit. 
• Status is easier to read: cosmetics have their own Style screen, consumables have their own screen, and text is larger. 
• Pet Treats now cook in batches of 3. 
• The app opens faster on the watch. Health data now syncs in the background.

FIXED 
• The watch face complication could get stuck on "Claim!". 
• Result cards no longer overflow on smaller watches. 
• The home-screen camp no longer slightly overlaps the Reaper class while in idle animation.

• Daily Crafting Bounty: turn in a Steel Bar, a Plank and a Leather Roll once a day for XP and morale
• Your watch face complication now shows your orc’s energy between quests
• Trade XP for War Paint on the Chroma screen
• Mounts now cost 5 Beast Tracks
• New orcs start with 90 morale
• New attack animations for Monk and Rogue
• Fixed a weapon aura crash on Apple Watch SE and a cave battle freeze
